description: Add to an existing note: append or prepend markdown, or insert a section after a named heading. Targets a note by id, or by title fragment when the id is unknown. Returns the note id and an edit id that undo_note_edit can revert. Does NOT rewrite or delete existing text; those edits are made in Selah itself.

note_id.description: UUID of the note to add to. Preferred when known (from find_notes, search_notes, read_note or create_note).

note_name.description: Title fragment of the note (e.g. 'Romans 8'), used when note_id is unknown.

operations.description: Additions to apply in order as one change.

op.description: append adds to the end, prepend to the start, insert_after_section directly after the named heading.

section.description: Heading text to target. Required for insert_after_section; ignored otherwise.

summary.description: Optional one-line description of the change, shown to the user.

name: edit_note
title: Add to note
